subject: Overgrowth and Rodent Control Ordinance Updates
overview: The committee met to discuss creating an overgrowth ordinance and amending existing rodent control regulations to improve public health enforcement and sidewalk accessibility. It approved a motion for the sponsor to draft the legislative language for both items in consultation with city departments and legal counsel.

items.title: Resolution to Discuss an Overgrowth Ordinance (24-036)
items.summary: Approved a motion for Vice President Collins to draft a new ordinance regulating vegetation on private property that obstructs public rights-of-way or provides harborage for pests. Discussion focused on using neighboring municipalities' codes as templates to empower building and health departments to enforce basic maintenance.

items.title: Updates to the Rodent Control Ordinance (24-461)
items.summary: Approved drafting amendments to redirect permit fees into a dedicated mitigation fund, increase street opening fees for utilities, and mandate that residents replace damaged trash barrels within 15 days. The updates also include higher fines for landlords of properties with more than three units and provisions to assist elderly residents with property maintenance.
